summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, reporting an amendment to its share purchase agreement for Anira Consulting FZC, acquired on June 2, 2026. The amendment changes the consideration structure: 1,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock become non-convertible, and a $5 million convertible note is replaced with a non-convertible zero-interest promissory note maturing June 2, 2028. The total purchase price remains $12 million, composed of common stock, Series B Preferred, and the note. The board approved the amendment on June 8, 2026. This represents a post-closing adjustment to deal terms, not a new special situation. Watch for any future restructuring or redemption of the preferred stock.
